Implemented compiled selected OLS and inverse-covariance fixed-effects estimates through ordinary public structural request, preparation and bounded dataset/sink APIs. Pivoted QR/readout preparation uses public Gale; optional variance/covariance is requested or required by the scientific route, without unwanted nuisance/full-fit maps. Run pooling retains the complete shared coefficient geometry and selected-scan partitions before applying output functionals. The unified SelectedEstimates entry point and description report actual topology, computations, retained/internal-only/not-requested/unavailable products, ranks/axes and read bounds. Unsupported noise/transform/coefficient requests fail explicitly; no scientific fallback or global cache is inferred.

Exact isolated base fd992a0c85001eb50ba2e78d29c497693ca494dc with PLS Neuro combined patch 58ff8af4dd57cfeabff7bc9a59f5e2323c2aa9e3cfd61e35596f502d333d7adf passes full fitJVM/test 274 and fitJS/test 265, including external-package examples. Evidence includes independent rational and mixed-TR R references, nuisance/rank/scaling/layout/row selection invariants, physical FIR coordinates, full-fit compatibility, backend product/stride observations, exclusions and read/cancellation/sink boundaries. Fourteen attributable source/documentation paths have been synchronized after prior-byte checks; unrelated native changes remain untouched. PLS Neuro public consumer and revision-bound integration probes pass and are recorded in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/docs/verification/selective-estimation-se2.md and its compressed logs. Local uncommitted implementation only; no publication claim.

Native throughput and richer executable examples remain bd-01M1ZAMKEPXXHF8342H0K70NSH. Bounded trace inspection, durable scientific output and broader GLS remain their existing issues. The first supported executor intentionally refuses those unadmitted operations; absent optional products do not imply downstream inference eligibility. The home-base epic remains active.
